note: Which roles a post is given when the staff roster creates its login, by job title as seeds/staff/staff-list.xlsx spells it. No names: a person is matched by their post, so a new holder of the post is given the same roles. Roles are applied only when the login is created, so a role taken away on screen is not added back by the next deploy (docs/guides/foundation.md §6.1, §11). TB, 16/10/2026. A post the sheet does not hold may say who it reports to (line_manager, in the words of the sheet's Line Manager column); the loader gives that line only while the person has none, so a manager set on screen stays. TB, 19/10/2026.

Operations & People Lead.work_email_note: The sheet has no email for this post. TB gave it on 16/10/2026.

Implementation Partner.line_manager_note: The build account, made by create-admin --build-account before any roster, is not in the sheet and keeps the login and role create-admin gave it. It reports to the CTO; its title stays Implementation Partner. TB, 19/10/2026.
